plugins.name: allium
plugins.description: Query blockchain data across 150+ chains with Allium. Search schemas, run SQL, read live prices and balances, and build Explorer queries, charts, and dashboards.

skills.name: allium-investigation
skills.description: Investigate an onchain entity, protocol, market, or wallet question with Allium. Use when the task needs a defensible analytical answer rather than a one-off lookup: check Terminal for existing coverage, select the right source, build the method from a small test to production, validate the result, make calibrated claims, and save reproducible Explorer queries (with an optional dashboard hand-off prompt for Allium Assistant). Chains after `data-matching` (source selection) rather than repeating it.
headings: 1. Check Terminal before investigating from scratch
2. Select the source before committing to a method
4. Build from a small test to a production query
skills.description_zh: 使用 Allium 调查链上实体、协议、市场或钱包，形成可辩护的分析：先查 Terminal 现有覆盖，选择来源，由小测试扩展至正式方法，验证结果并作有分寸的结论，保存可复现 Explorer 查询，可附仪表板交接提示。接在 data-matching 来源选择之后，不重复选源，适用于深入调查而非一次查询。

skills.name: bridge-analysis
skills.description: Methodology playbook for analyzing cross-chain bridge and messaging-protocol data on Allium — CCTP, LayerZero, Wormhole, Across, canonical/application bridges, and general lock-and-mint flows. Use whenever a question touches bridge transfer volume, net flows between chains, tracing a specific cross-chain transaction, or attributing bridge activity to a protocol/integrator — even if the user just names a bridge or asks to "trace this transfer across chains." Covers the direction/double-counting mechanics and non-EVM tracing gap that come up repeatedly before you write the SQL. Distinct from a formal third-party coverage benchmark (see bridge-protocol-coverage-assessment for that) — this is the lighter-weight reference for getting an individual bridge query right.
headings: Bridge transfer tables record net single-directional flows, not always both legs
Filtering to ≥2 target chains creates a double-counting trap a single-chain filter doesn't have
Bridge identity is derivable onchain; integrator/aggregator attribution is not
Tracing a specific transfer when there's no direct join key
skills.description_zh: 指导 Allium 跨链桥及消息协议分析，包括 CCTP、LayerZero、Wormhole、Across、原生或应用桥及锁定铸造流程。用于转移量、链间净流、单笔追踪和协议或集成商归因，编 SQL 前处理方向、重复计数及非 EVM 追踪缺口；单次查询参考，不替代正式覆盖基准评估。

skills.name: dashboard-design
skills.description: Build and update Allium Explorer dashboards with set_dashboard. Use when the user wants a dashboard created, edited, or laid out from Explorer queries.
skills.description_zh: 使用 set_dashboard 从 Allium Explorer 查询创建、更新或排布仪表板。

skills.name: data-matching
skills.description:
Match an analytical question to the right Allium table, metric, dashboard, or
realtime endpoint. Required when selecting a new data source for a query or
analysis: define the intended meaning, compare schema candidates, test
coverage, and record the fit and caveats before treating a source as correct.
Run this before `allium-investigation` or any other analysis.
headings: 1. Translate the question into a data contract
4. Prove coverage before building the analysis
skills.description_zh: 将分析问题匹配到 Allium 表、指标、仪表板或实时接口：定义含义、比较候选模式、测试覆盖并记录适配与限制，之后才能认定来源正确。用于新分析选源，须先于 allium-investigation 或其他分析。

skills.name: dex-analysis
skills.description: Methodology playbook for analyzing DEX/AMM trade, liquidity, and pricing data on Allium — Uniswap, PancakeSwap, PumpSwap/Pump.fun, Orca, Pendle, aggregators (0x, 1inch), and perp DEXs like Hyperliquid. Use whenever a question touches swap volume, trade counts, liquidity positions, impermanent loss, aggregator fee/routing analysis, or DEX-derived token prices — even if the user just names a protocol or asks why a number "looks off" compared to a known reference. Covers the per-hop double-counting, protocol-vs-project grouping, and fee-leg reconstruction pitfalls that come up repeatedly before you write the SQL.
headings: Trade rows are often per-hop, not per-swap
Group by protocol for AMM-math questions, by project for branding
Aggregator trades often need a join for basic fields, and hide their fee as a transfer
skills.description_zh: 指导 Allium DEX/AMM 交易、流动性和定价分析，涵盖 Uniswap、PancakeSwap、PumpSwap/Pump.fun、Orca、Pendle、0x/1inch 及 Hyperliquid 等永续 DEX。用于交换量、交易数、流动性头寸、无常损失、聚合器费用路由及代币价格；编 SQL 前处理逐跳重复计数、协议与项目分组和费用分支重建。

skills.name: explorer-visuals
skills.description: Attach charts to Allium Explorer queries. Use when the user wants a chart, graph, pie, table, map, sankey, treemap, or value card on a query result.
skills.description_zh: 为 Allium Explorer 查询结果添加图表，包括折线等图形、饼图、表、地图、桑基图、矩形树图或数值卡。

skills.name: lending-analysis
skills.description: Methodology playbook for analyzing DeFi lending protocol data on Allium — Aave, Morpho, Fluid, Euler, Maple, Compound-style forks, and per-chain lending markets. Use whenever a question touches deposits, borrows, liquidations, collateral swaps, utilization, TVL, or leverage on a lending protocol — even if the user just names a protocol/asset or asks to compare two lending metrics tables. Covers the table-per-event-type join gotchas, column-naming inconsistencies, and liquidation-fill double-counting that come up repeatedly before you write the SQL.
headings: Coverage is broader than Aave, and uneven across event types
No table labels "collateral swap" or "debt swap" — derive it from a join
Join performance: filter by date before joining by hash
Column names are inconsistent across tables — check before assuming
Ranking by volume: exclude nulls, don't let them win
Utilization: compute per-asset, not just protocol-level
TVL/metrics tables aren't a linear pipeline — and don't always agree
Liquidation fills: check cardinality on both sides of a join
skills.description_zh: 指导 Allium DeFi 借贷分析，涵盖 Aave、Morpho、Fluid、Euler、Maple、Compound 类分叉及各链市场。用于存借款、清算、抵押物交换、利用率、TVL、杠杆和借贷指标表对比；编 SQL 前处理按事件分表的连接问题、列名不一致和清算成交重复计数。

skills.name: product-guide
skills.description:
Guide to Allium's four core products: Explorer, Realtime APIs, Datastreams,
and Datashares. Explains what each product does, who it's for, and how to
choose the right one for a customer's use case.

Read this skill when a customer asks about Allium's products, wants to
understand the difference between them, needs help choosing a product, or
asks questions like "which product should I use?" or "what does Allium offer?"
It also carries the canonical, dated list of supported blockchains — read it
for any "what chains / how many chains does Allium support?" question and cite
that list instead of answering from memory.
headings: How to Choose the Right Product
skills.description_zh: 解释 Allium Explorer、Realtime APIs、Datastreams 和 Datashares 的功能、适用对象及选用方法。也提供带日期的权威支持链清单；回答支持哪些或多少链时须读取并引用该清单。

skills.name: rwa-analysis
skills.description: Methodology playbook for analyzing tokenized real-world assets (RWA) on Allium — tokenized treasuries, money market funds, tokenized equities/pre-IPO stocks, commodities, and private credit. Use whenever a question touches RWA supply, AUM, market cap, holders, mint/burn activity, or classification — even if the user just says "tokenized treasuries," "BUIDL," "tokenized stocks," "money market fund AUM growth," or names a specific RWA product/issuer. Covers the aggregation mistakes, classification pitfalls, and data-quality exclusions that come up repeatedly in real RWA questions before you write the SQL.
headings: Multi-chain products: sum across chains, but say so
Classification: risk factor, not legal wrapper
Pre-IPO / tokenized equities: no shortcut flag exists
Missing prices: don't report a blank
Exclude known bad-data tokens before ranking
Geography is a proxy, not a measurement
Time windows: don't trust a relative default for "all of [year]"
skills.description_zh: 指导 Allium 代币化真实资产分析，包括国债、货币市场基金、股票或上市前股份、商品及私人信贷。用于供给、AUM、市值、持有人、铸造销毁及分类；编 SQL 前处理聚合错误、分类陷阱和数据质量排除项。

skills.name: sql-optimization
skills.description:
**Required reading before writing or running any SQL.** Patterns for Snowflake
query performance and chain-specific pitfalls.

Covers: default time ranges, partition-pruning rules, CTE filtering, `QUALIFY`
for dedup, `UNION ALL` over `UNION`, `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT` for exploration,
pre-aggregated `*.metrics.*` tables vs raw aggregation, EVM address lowercasing
(and when not to), per-chain vs `crosschain.*` tables, verifying guessed
categorical filter values with `SELECT DISTINCT`, and Solana voting/non-voting
optimized views.

Call `get_skill(name="sql-optimization")` before writing SQL —
especially for large tables, long time ranges, or crosschain queries.
headings: Partition pruning does NOT work with subquery values
Select only the columns you need
skills.description_zh: 为 Allium Snowflake SQL 提供性能与链特性规则，编写或运行 SQL 前须读取。涵盖默认时间窗、分区裁剪、CTE 过滤、QUALIFY 去重、UNION ALL、探索用近似去重计数、预聚合指标表、地址大小写、单链与跨链表、分类过滤值验证及 Solana 投票优化视图，尤其适用于大表、长窗口和跨链查询。

skills.name: stablecoin-analysis
skills.description: Methodology playbook for analyzing stablecoin volume, supply, holders, and geographic usage on Allium — USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, RLUSD, USDG, JPYC, and other fiat/crypto/ algorithmic-backed stablecoins. Use whenever a question touches stablecoin transfer volume, circulating supply, wallet/holder counts, geo splits, or cross-chain deployments — even if the user just names a specific stablecoin, asks for "adoption" or "usage" numbers, or asks to compare volume to a chart/number they already have. Covers the raw-vs-adjusted volume distinction, chain-specific double-counting mechanics, and address/case-sensitivity gotchas that come up repeatedly before you write the SQL.
headings: Raw volume overstates organic activity — use adjusted
Always check for fake/bad-data tokens before trusting a total
Address conventions are chain-specific — don't apply one rule everywhere
Native vs. bridged deployments are separate supplies on the same chain
Holders and geography need the right table, and neither table alone is complete
Routed/DEX volume is not float growth
skills.description_zh: 指导 Allium 稳定币转移量、供给、持有人、地理使用和跨链部署分析，涵盖 USDC、USDT、DAI、USDS、RLUSD、USDG、JPYC 及法币、加密或算法支持稳定币。用于采用量、使用量和与既有图数对比；编 SQL 前区分原始与调整量、各链重复计数及地址大小写问题。
